title: Ravi's $12 Delivery Fees Cost $1,250 a Year

scenes.say: $1,250 a year. Not on food. On delivery extras.
Ravi orders dinner twice a week. Each order has about $12 of extras.
And that's before menu prices, which are often a little higher in the app.
Over 3 years, the extras alone come to about $3,750. That's a nice weekend trip, every year.
His fix: pick up one order a week. Same food, half the extras.
That's about $625 a year back, for a 10-minute drive to the restaurant.
How many delivery orders a week? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because $12 extra, twice a week, is $1,250 a year.
